communication_goal: 明确 AI 提供建议，人类对批准结果负责。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at left beside a small desk, holding a large rectangular clipboard upright at the center of the composition. The clipboard has a prominent metal clip, a single blank paper sheet and NO writing or check marks. Keep the entire clipboard clear, including its bottom edge, separated from the hands enough for a complete object crop. The programmer points toward the floating white OpenAI knot on the right while discussing accountability. No laptop is needed.

image_review.summary: 通过：黑底白线单幅插画，一个成年火柴人和一个可辨认的白色 OpenAI 六环结标识，底图无对白文字。夹板顶部纸夹、板体四边完整可见；握持的手轻遮左缘，裁剪保留正常握持语境，不能框成孤立纸张。额外盆栽与杯子不参与教学。
